topic: The AI workflow that follows up with every no-show automatically
findings: AI-powered appointment reminders reduce no-shows by 29% (Acuity)
AI no-show recovery workflows can recapture 20-30% of no-shows that already happened by automatically re-engaging and rebooking them
A practice losing $50,000-$80,000 annually to no-shows can recover roughly $14,500-$23,200 in revenue with AI-powered reminder and recovery workflows
Service businesses using a full AI booking layer see ~34% more bookings captured and ~47% less time spent on phone admin
